title: Provision lore agent profiles for specialist dispatch
description: The opum-workflow specialist agents (reviewer, implementer, verifier, documenter) are gated on lore review context packs whose profiles live in .lore/agents/, and ward-cli is the only fleet repository with none (verified by the orchestrator 2026-09-28). Provision .lore/agents/review.toml, implementation.toml, verification.toml and documentation.toml, modeled on a sibling repository's profiles (read by ref, e.g. opum-fleet origin/dev), with the sources adjusted to ward-cli's own docs bundle (docs/adr/, docs/index.md). Acceptance: the four profiles exist and lore agent context review compiles a pack that names ward-cli sources; CI stays green (lore check, docs gate).

acceptanceCriteria.text: The four profiles exist: .lore/agents/{review,implementation,verification,documentation}.toml, modeled on a sibling repository, with sources drawn from the ward-cli docs bundle (docs/index.md and docs/adr/)

For each profile, `lore agent context <profile> --task ...` exits 0 with stderr carrying no agent-profile-not-found warning, and the pack source catalog is drawn from the profile declared sources (OPAG-688)
`lore check` exits 0 and the PR head SHA is green in Check, Docs and Tracker integrity

plan: Write the four .lore/agents/*.toml profiles with ward-cli bundle sources
Prove each profile: exit 0, no not-found warning on stderr, catalog from profile sources (OPAG-688); lore check; test suite
Commit, push, open PR into dev; required checks green on the head SHA
Close WCLI-24 in the PR with evidence; merge on own-user authority; prune local branch
Promote dev to main at orchestrator direction and report to opum-agent
implementationNotes: Handoff, 2026-09-28, session renewal at the WCLI-20 boundary (orchestrator OPAG-475). The successor starts WCLI-24 here. Context: the opum-workflow reviewer specialist refuses dispatch in this repo because its lore context pack needs .lore/agents/review.toml, and ward-cli has never had any lore agent profiles (the only fleet repo without them; verified by the orchestrator by ref). Task, per the orchestrator: provision .lore/agents/ with review, implementation, verification and documentation profiles, modeled on a sibling read by ref (e.g. git -C ../opum-fleet show origin/dev:.lore/agents/review.toml), with sources adjusted to ward-cli's own docs bundle. Acceptance: the four profiles exist; lore agent context review compiles a pack naming ward-cli sources; CI stays green (the Docs job runs lore check). Method notes: (1) merge authority is not inherited — ask your own user before gh pr merge. (2) The profiles are committed under .lore/, which is not gitignored; land via the usual branch+PR path. (3) Part 2 of the original finding (lore agent context review exits 0 with a warning where the reviewer protocol documented exit 3) was ruled behaviour and routed to opum-fleet — nothing to do here. Skills for the successor: opum-handoff restore, opum-sdlc, lore.

Starting WCLI-24 after opum-agent confirmed the fleet restart. Before-state measured in this session as the positive control for the OPAG-688 criterion: with no .lore/agents/ present, `lore agent list` reports none, and `lore agent context review --task ...` exits 0 with a stderr warning that agent profile review was not found, plus an empty allowed-source catalog (bundle-wide query hits only). The four profile names were confirmed against opum-workflow 0.10.10 specialist prompts: reviewer/implementer/verifier/documenter each call `lore agent context <name>`. Sibling shape read by ref at origin/dev from opum-fleet, quest-cli and opum-doc; sources adjusted to the five concept ids in this bundle: index and adr/0001..adr/0004.

The independent review (opum-workflow reviewer, dispatched once the profiles existed in the working tree, so it accepted dispatch where it previously refused) returned no HIGH and no MEDIUM. LOW 1: the documentation profile description named SECURITY.md, which is not tracked at this commit (planned per adr/0002 and WCLI-15); fixed to 'the planned SECURITY.md (WCLI-15)' in this PR. LOW 2: addition drift is silent — a scratch copy adding adr/0005 keeps lore check --strict and all four catalogs green and unchanged; removal or rename is loud (lore agent context exits 6, lore check exits 6, lore agent list errors). Filed as WCLI-25. The reviewer also independently verified: catalog equality and 0-byte stderr across 16 invocations at two task texts; the degraded control still warns (exit 0, not 3 — the exit-3 claim in the specialist prompt is the already-routed opum-fleet item); budgets (~6.2k-6.6k of 10k-12k, truncated false; the exit-6 path positively controlled at --max-tokens 500); five gates green; sibling profile shape; and no contradiction with CLAUDE.md, the repository profile, or fleet rules. Versions resolved: lore 0.11.0 (local and the CI Docs pin), quest 0.11.0 (local and the version Tracker integrity installs), bun 1.3.14, node v24.20.0. The final head is re-gated: CI runs again on this closure commit, and the ruleset requires Check, Docs and Tracker integrity green on the SHA being merged.
finalSummary: The four .lore/agents/{review,implementation,verification,documentation}.toml profiles land in opum-ai/ward-cli#25 (squash into dev). Proof per OPAG-688 at lore 0.11.0: for each profile, `lore agent context` exits 0, stderr is empty (no agent-profile-not-found warning), and the pack catalog equals the profile declared pinned+sources exactly (machine-compared) — against a measured degraded-pack control taken before the change. Check, Docs and Tracker integrity are green on the PR head SHA bc578ea (workflow run 36489864713), and the ruleset re-enforces them on the final head at merge. Independent review (opum-workflow reviewer): no HIGH or MEDIUM findings; both LOW ones dispositioned — the SECURITY.md wording fixed in this PR, the addition-drift maintenance gap filed as WCLI-25.
